blockingReasons: The upstream candidate is recorded for review but has not been merged or validated against the Halo product tree.
The pinned initial-import base commit cannot be resolved in the shallow/grafted read-only candidate tree, so incremental-sync ancestry is unproven.

The declared initial-import tree fba189b8b3db23c45a4bfed18c0250018b251387 does not reproduce from the recorded file manifest (derived tree f6a559f45e266945921913f9752eb0e5b4609bdb); base tree provenance requires reconciliation.
The canonical UTF-8 candidate diff is recorded separately from the legacy C-quoted count anomaly and still requires manual product/runtime review.
Pi 0.83.0 always loads the built-in llama.cpp inline extension; it is not disabled by --no-extensions and is excluded from the Halo release until its capability boundary is separately approved.
The Pi host reference tree has no Git metadata, so its source commit/tag cannot be proved.
The Pi host package is not a Halo lockfile dependency and its complete transitive license evidence is not a Halo release artifact.
No exact desktop distribution artifact has been recorded for the license/notice inclusion check.
The Halo Cargo workspace lists src/crates/adapters/pi-rpc-adapter twice; this task reports the boundary defect without modifying Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock.
The audit must remain fail-closed until the required verification matrix produces fresh evidence.

allowlistedFindings.reason: The match is a negative guard literal used to reject a legacy BitFun-main path; it is not used as a build or runtime input path.

The only absolute paths are fixed #[cfg(test)] session-scope fixtures; the production runtime does not use them as build or runtime inputs. The file hash pins this exception to the audited fixture source.

builtInExtensions.policy: blocked until a Git-pinned, license-complete, offline-capable Pi host or an audited replacement is supplied

capabilities.process: inherits the full Pi child-process permission; no direct child-process spawn observed

load.pathPolicy: Only the adapter-owned temporary copy of the embedded, hash-verified source may be passed to --extension.

impact.files: No direct file API; the host adapter writes one verified temporary source copy and removes its owned directory.
impact.network: None in extension source; provider network remains Pi/host scope and is not an extension capability.
impact.process: None in extension source; it runs inside the Pi child process.
impact.credentials: No credential API, environment read, auth.json access, or secret transport in extension source.
impact.renderer: None; only RPC extension UI confirmation is requested.

extensions.hostPermissions: The extension inherits the launching user's Pi process permissions and is not a sandbox. Halo Workbench Runtime owns trust, redaction, one-shot decisions, and fail-closed lifecycle behavior.

runtime.evidence: The extension has no package.json and its only import is type-only. The Halo package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, and Cargo.lock contain no @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent runtime entry.

host.runtimeSuppliedBy: User-installed Pi; not bundled by Halo P0.
host.directDependencies: Not a Halo extension runtime dependency; host package closure is not admitted to the Halo lockfile.
host.transitiveDependencies: Not imported or audited as Halo release dependencies; exact closure is unavailable for this gate.

dependencyClosure.evidence: The Pi host lockfiles are outside Halo's lockfile boundary and no complete release-time closure/notice artifact is admitted.

licenseEvidence.releaseStatus: Not a Halo distribution artifact; do not infer or treat as Halo release evidence.

requiredText: MIT license and the upstream copyright notice

license.status: blocked until an exact release artifact is inspected

extensions.updateResponsibility: Halo Studio maintainers. Any source, embedded-loader, host-permission, or dependency change increments the fixed version and requires new source commit/hash/license evidence and fresh contract verification.
